name: Funny Nurse Mug, Pink Marble with Gold Print (14 oz)
seoTitle: Funny Pink Marble Nurse Mug with Gold Print
metaDescription: A funny 14 oz pink marbled nurse mug with gold print that arrives gift boxed. A pretty pick for graduation, retirement, or Nurses Week.
summary: A pink marbled ceramic mug with a funny gold print saying, already gift boxed. Pretty enough for a desk and easy to hand over at graduation or retirement.
whyItWorks: Gift boxed mugs save a step, and that matters when you are grabbing something on the way to a pinning ceremony or a retirement party. The pink marble look with gold lettering feels a bit dressier than a standard white mug, so it reads as a real gift rather than a last minute grab from the break room shelf.

At 14 oz, it holds a little more than a typical mug, which any nurse who drinks coffee through a 12 hour shift will appreciate. The funny saying gives it personality, and the style suits a wide range of moments: a nursing student finishing school, a nurse practitioner starting a new role, or a veteran nurse heading into retirement after decades on the floor. Tuck a few tea bags or a bag of chocolate inside the box for a little extra. It is also a good choice for a school nurse, who often has a desk where a pretty mug can sit on display.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the exact funny saying so it fits the person's humor.
Gold print can be delicate, so confirm care instructions such as hand washing or microwave use on the listing.
Arrives in a gift box, which helps if you are short on time.

faq.q: Is this a good retirement gift for a nurse?
faq.a: Yes. It feels a bit more special than a basic mug and arrives boxed, which makes it easy to give at a retirement party.

faq.q: Can it go in the microwave?
faq.a: Gold print often cannot, so check the care notes on the listing before reheating coffee in it.
